name: opencode-panel
description: An OpenCode chat pane for the VS Code secondary sidebar: streamed answers, syntax-highlighted snippets, and a type-it-yourself workflow.

chatSessions.name: opencode
chatSessions.description: Sessions from the local OpenCode server

commands.title: OpenCode: Delete Current Session in Pane
OpenCode: Open Existing Session in Pane
OpenCode: Import VS Code Chat into Pane
OpenCode: Backport Pane Session to VS Code Chat
OpenCode: Open Session in VS Code Chat

opencodePanel.serverUrl.markdownDescription: Override the OpenCode server URL (for example `http://100.x.y.z:4096` for a home server over Tailscale). Leave empty to auto-discover the local background service from its registration file.

opencodePanel.serverPassword.markdownDescription: Password for a remote OpenCode server (`opencode service set password` on the server). Sent as HTTP Basic `opencode:<password>`. Leave empty for a local auto-discovered service. You can also embed it as `http://opencode:password@host:port` in `serverUrl`.

opencodePanel.remoteDirectory.markdownDescription: Directory as seen by a remote OpenCode server (for example `/home/you/code/my-repo` on your home server). When set with `serverUrl`, sessions are scoped to this path instead of the local workspace folder, because agent tools run where the server runs.

opencodePanel.agent.markdownDescription: Optional agent ID to use for new sessions. Leave empty to use the server default.

opencodePanel.model.markdownDescription: Optional model to use for new sessions, as `provider/model` (for example `opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free`). Leave empty to use the server default.

opencodePanel.showReasoning.description: Show model reasoning (thinking) parts in the panel.

opencodePanel.stripColorEmoji.description: Strip color-square emojis (🟥 🟦 ⬛) from model output. CSS snippets already show real color swatches, so the emojis are redundant.

opencodePanel.fontScale.markdownDescription: Text size of the OpenCode pane, as a zoom factor. Also adjustable from Menu > Text size.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && pnpm run package && code --install-extension ./opencode-panel.vsix --force && pnpm run enable-proposed-api
